# smix

> smix is a UI test runner for iOS and Android, built as a Claude Code sub-product. Tests are authored in maestro-compatible yaml (or the Rust / TypeScript / Swift / Kotlin SDKs) and driven through an accessibility-first sensing stack — a11y tree, Vision OCR, then a local-`claude` AI-assertion tier. Simulators, emulators and physical devices are all addressable; a physical one must be registered by hand first, wiping it needs a second per-device opt-in, and a verb a phone has no equivalent for errors rather than quietly doing nothing. Failures are AI-readable: every miss carries visible elements and suggested fixes.

This file is generated by `scripts/dev/gen-llms.py` from `smix_verbs::VERB_TABLE`, the `Selector` enum, and the workspace version. Do not edit by hand — the ship gate regenerates and diffs it.

## Selectors

The `Selector` taxonomy (11 variants) — the target language for every find / tap / assert. The base forms resolve on the a11y tree; the later layers add locale text, Vision OCR, anchor-relative coordinates, a raw normalized point, and a first-hit fallback chain. See `docs/ai-guide/03-selectors.md`.

- **Text** — `{ text: 'hello' | /^hi/, ...modifiers }`
- **Id** — `{ id: 'btn-xyz', ...modifiers }`
- **Label** — `{ label: 'Settings', ...modifiers }`
- **Role** — `{ role: 'button', name?: pattern, ...modifiers }`
- **Focused** — `{ focused: true }` — no modifiers (focus is runtime-resolved).
- **Anchor** — `{ anchor: { ...spatial keys }, ...indexModifiers }`
- **LocalizedText** — `{ localized_text: { en: "Submit", ja: "送信", es: "Enviar" }, ...modifiers }`
- **OcrText** — `{ ocr_text: "Submit", locales: ["en"], ...modifiers }` — sense
- **AnchorRelative** — `{ anchored: { anchor: <selector>, dx: -0.15, dy: 0 } }` — sense
- **Point** — `{ point: [0.5, 0.9] }` — sense layer L7 (last-resort within a
- **Fallback** — `{ fallback: [<selector1>, <selector2>, ...] }` — sense layer L7.

## Install

```bash
# Rust CLI + SDK
cargo install smix-cli --locked

# TypeScript / Node / Bun
npm install @goliapkg/smix

# Swift Package Manager
# add https://github.com/goliajp/smix (product: SmixSDK, from: "6.7.0")

# Gradle / Maven (Kotlin / Java) — current release:
# implementation("jp.golia.smix:smix-sdk:6.7.0")
```

Prerequisites: macOS with Xcode + Simulator (iOS); Android SDK with an emulator image (Android).

## MCP

smix exposes the simulator to an agent over MCP — launch, look, tap, type, assert, with no yaml in between. Bring the runner up first (`smix runner up <udid> --bundle <id>`); the MCP server talks to the runner, it does not start it. Full setup + client JSON config: `docs/ai-guide/11-mcp.md`.

## Iron rules

- **Simulator only.** Any physical-device code path is rejected by construction.
- **Sensing is a11y-first, then OCR, then AI.** No multi-provider VLM abstraction — the AI tier is a local `claude` CLI.
- **No coordinates or xpath in the selector surface.** The one escape hatch is `App::tap_at_coord(nx, ny)` — a normalized-0..1 tap wired directly to the native event chain, not a Selector.
- **No bare `sleep` verb.**
- **Failures must be AI-readable** — every failure carries visible elements and suggestions.

## Upgrading

- [To 4.0](docs/migrating-to-4.md): device records and leases moved to the machine; `smix sim migrate` and `smix lease migrate` copy the old ones over. Two Rust signatures changed.
- [To 3.0](docs/migrating-to-3.md): `fill` replaces the field it names, and two other behaviours changed.
